property_summary: For every input, the reference contract invokes transferFrom exactly once for every recipient in `_tos` (so a recording callee sees exactly `_tos.length` calls), while the buggy version skips the first recipient and therefore records only `_tos.length - 1` calls for any non-empty `_tos`.
change_summary: Change the loop initialization to start at i=1 so the first recipient is skipped.
